title: Rename Semio Model to Representation
description: Rename the semio-domain term "model" to "representation" across the semio/ technology, using the repo CLI `rename` command. Extend the CLI with a scope path argument so the rename can be limited to semio/ without touching other technologies (elements, coda) or historical .repo/ records. Apply the rename, verify builds/tests, and close.
summary: Consolidated the Rust async kit backbone into semio/rs/lib.rs by ensuring the native-only inline module owns the public backbone API, keeping the authority runtime as KitBackboneAuthority, removing the standalone kit_backbone_async.rs source, and verifying the existing async backbone tests through the full Rust test suite. Updated the remote backbone test path to the current kind-based wire discriminator. Verification: cargo fmt and cargo test from semio/rs passed with 83 passed, 1 ignored.
